correctness.rationale: For q=3 each of 20 six-coloring permutations contributes 6 or -3 at balanced frequencies, giving W=9a-60 nonzero, and explicit frequency 98 attains 3. For q=4 exact integer full 20-stage Walsh transform agrees on each of 513 S5 x GL(2,2) balanced-frequency orbits with direct sums over 12960 words. The 83-level CSV matches all multiplicities; Parseval, 14790 extra balanced zeros, weight-six first zeros, 16 minimum, and absolute projection-kernel sum 87263536 are checked. Group averaging proves unrestricted projection optimality, so no numerical optimization or extrapolation is used.
